title: Spotify says yes, it is busting people for using Family Plan sharing too widely
summary: Spotify co-CEO Alex Norström confirmed on this week's earnings call that the company is trying to catch Spotify Family plan users who don't actually live together with a new QR code verification method that requires scanning the plan manager's phone.
